target_customer: Startups and modern companies in Brazil with roughly 30 to 500 employees, buying through HR and operations leaders
problem: Mid sized companies stitch together many HR and admin point tools. They want one customizable system their HR team can adapt without engineers.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription plus optional bundles of implementation and consulting hours
product_category: No-code HR platform, later an all-in-one company OS with an AI studio

founders.name: Murilo Narciso
founders.background_notes: YC page: software engineer who joined Quero at 150 employees and helped scale it past 700, and built an HR app called Rio used weekly by 70% of staff. Education not listed.

founders.name: Roger Garcia
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder in the November 2023 Startups.com.br article.

founders.name: Alexandre Maluli
founders.background_notes: Named in the November 2023 Startups.com.br article; met co-founders through founder matchmaking programs.

technical_complexity.rationale: A configurable no-code HR suite with many modules is standard SaaS engineering with hard parts in the flexible workflow engine; the later AI studio adds more.

defensibility.rationale: HR data and configured workflows create switching costs, but HR suites and workflow tools are plentiful and copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The 2023 article names these as HR solutions addressing different needs. None was found copying the no-code HR wedge; the company remains active.

market_need_then: Brazilian startups were growing fast in 2021 and HR teams depended on engineering for custom tools. The founder had built an internal HR app at Quero Education that most staff used weekly.

branding.domain_note: Uses zazos.com per the company site; acquisition history not found.

identity.logo: Wordmark with a lightning bolt symbol (the name is stylized zaz with a bolt then os)
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct; compares itself openly with rivals and offers 'honest comparisons with trade offs'

rebrands.why: Not sourced; the YC page now shows the product as a custom all-in-one OS.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence about the brand was found; the stylized name with an emoji is distinctive but hard to type.

pivots.to: Custom all-in-one company OS with AI Studio and MCP integrations
pivots.why: Per the company site and YC page, software became cheap to build so each company can have its own OS.

outcome_analysis: Zazos is still active and small. A founder with HR scaling experience at a YC company built a no-code HR product for Brazilian startups, raised about 2.4 million dollars by late 2023 led by Quiet Capital, and aimed at break even. It has since repositioned around AI built custom company software. No exit or shutdown found, and later rounds were not found.
notes: The round has no stated stage or date; the Nov 2023 article says R$12M (US$2.4M) raised to date, led by Quiet Capital, with YC participating, and the amount is cumulative. Aggregators (Extruct, BounceWatch, Persana) show a seed dated 2021-10-04 at either $125K or $2.3M; not recorded as separate rounds. Norte Ventures is named as a backer on the company site. Competitors: Gupy, Flash, Caju and Swile appear only in a 2023 article, two years after the batch, and the site names Gupy, Espresso and Lovable today; no source dated near mid 2021 was found, so the list is empty. Founders other than Narciso are from press, not the YC page, and may not all have been present at founding.
